surface: Command Center v2 - Owner's Evidence Desk
decision: No new production raster assets are required. The approved composition is a semantic operations interface; the only bitmap role is the existing authoritative Filosage mark already rendered by FilosageMark.

direct.source_crop: Approved comps A-C header brand role; generated crest details are not literal brand assets.
direct.strategy: Reuse the existing production asset through src/components/FilosageMark.tsx; no conversion, crop, or duplication.
direct.dimensions: 600x600 intrinsic; responsive display size remains owned by the existing shell component.
direct.deviations: Uses the real Filosage mark instead of the inconsistent generated crests in the comps.

direct.source_crop: Approved comps A-C header brand role; inverse placement for the existing dark learning-app header.
direct.strategy: Reuse the existing production inverse asset through src/components/FilosageMark.tsx; no conversion, crop, or duplication.
direct.dimensions: 600x600 intrinsic; responsive display size remains owned by the existing shell component.
direct.deviations: Preserves the authoritative application shell rather than literalizing the comps' generated header marks.

semantic.implementation: Compose the oatmeal canvas and single cream evidence sheet with route-scoped CSS using existing brand tokens such as --canvas, --surface, --line, and --grain-sheet; CSS owns boundaries, clipping, and responsive stacking.
semantic.notes: Do not rasterize the paper surface or use the full-page comp as a background.

semantic.implementation: Use semantic header/nav regions, labeled buttons or links, a deep navy safety band, text state labels, and Lucide icons. Preserve focus order, visible labels, and 44px minimum mobile targets.
semantic.notes: No custom icon sheet or navigation bitmap is needed.

semantic.implementation: Render the queue as a semantic list or table and the selected case as article/section content. CSS owns ruled separators, the teal selected edge, risk/status colors, two-column evidence groups, timeline rules, and desktop queue-plus-dossier versus mobile list-to-detail behavior.
semantic.notes: All case text and evidence remain live repository-backed HTML; no screenshot fragments.

semantic.implementation: Build Reviews with semantic pending lists and document sections, and System with full-width definition/table structures grouped as available, blocked, and future. Use Lucide icons and text labels together; CSS owns rules and restrained state fills.
semantic.notes: Supporting comps B and C govern composition only; their invented example values must not ship.

semantic.implementation: Use Source Serif 4 via --font-editorial only for the Command Center page title and Inter via existing body tokens for operations. Build the sticky safe-action dock as semantic buttons with CSS borders/fills; visually isolate Publish to learner and preserve its confirmation contract.
semantic.notes: No text, button, or decorative treatment is baked into imagery.

assumptions: The existing AppShell and FilosageMark remain the source of truth for brand chrome.
Lucide React remains the production icon source.
The existing brand token sheet and route-scoped CSS Module are sufficient for the approved paper-and-rules material system.
